title: 2x Kohlrabi Superschmelz Plug Plants – Giant White/Green Variety - Hardy Variety
description:
Kohlrabi Superschmelz is a

 giant white-green variety

that can reach up to

 8kg

over a long season. Despite its size, it stays

 tender and non-stringy

. It is slow-growing, heat-tolerant, and does not run to seed in hot weather.

 Product Details:

   Type:
  
  Kohlrabi Superschmelz (Hardy Biennial)
 

   Supplied As:
  
  2x plug plants
 

   Height:
  
  9–12 inches
 

   Flavour:
  
  Mild, tender flesh even when large
 

   Uses:
  
  Salads, cooking, roasting, stir-fries, storage
 

 Growing Information:

   Germination:
  
  6–10 days
 

   Temperature:
  
  15–28°C+
 

   Days to Maturity:
  
  55–65
 

   Light:
  
  Full sun
 

   Sowing/Planting Months:
  
  March–August
 

   Harvest Months:
  
  June–September
 

 Tips:

  Grows best in cool weather with steady moisture.
 

  Plant in fertile, well-drained soil.
 

  Thin to 10 inches apart once established.
 

  Mulch around the base to retain moisture.
 

  Water well during hot or dry spells.
 

  Harvest when bulbs are around 3 inches across, or leave to grow larger – they stay tender.
